# Sole authority for the upstream identity and source disposition of the ORVD
# Radau5 research backend. Other repository documents describe policy and
# numerical behaviour but do not restate mutable source identity.
#
# Dispositions:
#   donor_derive   not copied verbatim at INT-01; selected logic may be carried
#                  into the narrowed C++ core at INT-03 with attribution and a
#                  corresponding modification record.
#   oracle_url     not copied, compiled by ORVD, installed or redistributed;
#                  the official URL may be fetched into a temporary directory
#                  for a one-off comparison with the pure-C++ core.
#   reference_only not copied or compiled; useful only for source audit.
#   discard        outside the admitted first-version boundary.
#
# The project owner explicitly chose URL-only identity for every Fortran oracle
# source. No Fortran source or Fortran digest belongs in this repository. A
# future fetch therefore establishes only that it came from the recorded URL at
# that time; it must not be described as byte-identical to an earlier fetch.

acquisition_date 2026-08-23
software_catalog_url https://www.unige.ch/~hairer/software.html

# Actual C++ donor archive. The archive is not committed; its digest identifies
# the bytes audited before any derived C++ source is admitted.
cpp_donor_archive_url https://www.unige.ch/~hairer/prog/IntegratorT.tgz
cpp_donor_archive_sha256 4b479b5fa4388565f08f8c693e089a67ec1642a46798f5bafe95a0a773a344cd
cpp_donor_archive_last_modified 2003-01-31T09:14:30Z
cpp_port_author Blake_Ashby
original_fortran_authors E_Hairer G_Wanner

# normalised; the upstream digest below deliberately identifies the original,
# not the normalised local file.

# Official Fortran oracle: URL-only by project-owner decision. These sources
# never enter the product CMake graph, installation, offline product bundle or
# repository. radau5.f requires dc_decsol.f and decsol.f for the admitted dense
# DECSOL path; dr1 is the M=I stiff Van der Pol driver used for a smoke check.
oracle_url radau5.f https://www.unige.ch/~hairer/prog/stiff/radau5.f
oracle_url dc_decsol.f https://www.unige.ch/~hairer/prog/stiff/dc_decsol.f
oracle_url decsol.f https://www.unige.ch/~hairer/prog/stiff/decsol.f
oracle_url dr1_radau5.f https://www.unige.ch/~hairer/prog/stiff/dr1_radau5.f

# The amplifier driver exercises a mass matrix and banded storage excluded from
# the first version. Its URL is retained only to explain why it is not an oracle
# qualification case.
reference_only_url dr2_radau5.f https://www.unige.ch/~hairer/prog/stiff/dr2_radau5.f
